integrity: Proof uses exact recurrence, polynomial gcds, weighted initial ideals and Bezout. Six finite exponent checks provide corroboration but do not establish all-exponent assertion.
scientific_limitations: Exact degrees proved only for n>=3 and m in {0,1,2,3} in characteristic zero; general higher orders remain open. Previous numerical cubic examples are credited. A complete priority examination and independent audit are not available.
title: First four exact geometric degrees for symmetric power-flow prolongations
